channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: San Diego Weekend Guide: Dec. 12-14 – Chrismukkah
item.description: San Diego County is decking every available hall this weekend with glowing menorahs, festive boat parades and enough Santa sightings to make the North Pole jealous. Hanukkah kicks off Sunday night, which means it’s officially Chrismukkah season - that glorious early aughts invention from “The O.C.” that Seth Cohen made cool.

item.title: United Airlines cleared to add regional flights out of Carlsbad airport
item.description: On a 4-1 vote, county supervisors approved the three-year lease, which also features two options for a one-year extension.

item.title: Two-day fair brings holiday magic to Broadway Pier this weekend
item.description: This handmade shopping festival will feature many local and regional makers, emerging brands, and artists.

item.title: Opinion: SDG&E profits while 1-in-3 households can’t pay utility bills
item.description: While Californians are struggling to pay their bills, private utilities are posting record profits. The Public Utilities Commission can change that.

item.title: UCSD water polo team plays for something bigger by connecting with disabled Mount Hope girl
item.description: About 18 months ago, the girl, Remi, was matched with the UC San Diego women’s water polo team through Team IMPACT, a national nonprofit.

item.title: California’s coastal cities paying the most for water, report says
item.description: California water suppliers pay more than double on average than what Nevada districts pay, and seven times more than suppliers in Arizona.

item.title: Bullet fired by deputy missed man who allegedly made threatening motion
item.description: Lakeside fire crews called in deputies after being summoned to evaluate a person believed to be overdosing.

item.title: First American, now United – as Palomar Airport gets busier, wary residents wonder what’s next
item.description: They also worry about safety concerns. And with a 20-year expansion plan for the airport, Carlsbad residents see their problems only getting worse.

item.title: Music maven adds author to resume with new ‘Hunt for Holiday Spirit’ children’s book
item.description: Jefferson Jay, perhaps best known as the driving force behind the San Diego Music Hall of Fame, has written his first book, a holiday tale.

item.title: Bicyclist killed when motorist hits his rear tire in Rancho Peñasquitos
item.description: The man was killed in the 12900 block of Salmon River Road, San Diego police said.
